member: Kofi — Structural Enclosure and Low-Cost Fabrication Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, Farah, the ground holds the full store on the raised reinforced concrete plinth (C10), where plinth means a flat concrete base spreading load to soil. Plain words, produce plus box and racks weigh little more than a small car on a patio slab. Numbers are floor load 2.45 kPa per the floor loading from produce alone (E48) and soil pressure 2.51 kPa per the soil pressure under plinth without concrete self-weight (E47), far below the 50 kPa minimum soil value per the spaworld.co.nz — Generic Concrete Slab or Pad Building Guide (E43), sane against one person per square metre.

Surya, Lena, Farah, the box stays light and repairable with the bolted galvanized steel angle support frame (C11), where galvanized means zinc-coated against rust and Polyurethane (PU) means rigid foam insulation. Plain words, thin steel corners plus foam panels carry wind while a separate ground rack keeps sun panels off the cold roof. Numbers are panels 10 to 14 kg per square metre per the bestsuppliers.com — PU polyurethane foam 100mm insulation board cold room panel sandwich panels (E37) and angle 1.80 kg per metre per the metals4u.co.uk — 40mm x 40mm x 3mm Galvanised Steel Angle | metals4U (E40), for the 2.00 by 2.00 by 2.20 m box per the steady cooling load and pull-down for 1 tonne box (E24), framed as shown per the Cold store structure: concrete plinth, PU panel box, steel angle frame, hinged door, PV ground rack (E49).

Surya, Lena, Farah, daily access fits people and crates through the single 900 mm insulated hinged door (C12). Plain words, low racks stacked three high keep lifts below shoulder height with air gaps for cleaning. Numbers are 900 mm door and 100 mm wall gap per the Interior plan and section: two side racks, centre aisle, 900 mm door, wall and floor air gaps (E36), sane against a household doorway. Not ready, because rack fixings and panel joints need joint agreement with Lena and Farah.
